note: Synthetic corpus variants, not independent merchant histories. Live-model results on one run; not proof of real-merchant effectiveness. Unexecuted cases are marked not run, never replayed. Two first attempts (EVAL-006, EVAL-037) were superseded after fixing bugs they exposed; both are listed under superseded_attempts.

superseded_attempts.reason: Gemini sent wait_for_event with an extra argument; validation denied it but the agent loop still ended the run, and the harness then waited for a new request before the scripted upload. Fixed in the loop (a denied wait is fed back to the model) and in the corpus script (staff send the file after replying); the 30-case run was restarted on the fixed code.

A Gemini request stalled for 38 minutes (the HTTP client's per-read timeout never fired); the harness timed out at READY_TO_SUBMIT. Fixed with a hard total deadline per model call (router.call_once), then EVAL-037 was re-run (part-037-rerun.json).
